officer.name: Police officer
officer.summary: Constables and officers on the beat, recruited and trained for each region.

station.name: Police station
station.summary: A station houses and equips officers; officers beyond the stations' capacity work at half strength.

equipment.name: Basic kit
equipment.summary: Radios, vehicles and protective gear of the standard issue.

equipment.name: Modern kit
equipment.summary: Patrol vehicles, body cameras and a digital case system in every station.

equipment.name: Advanced kit
equipment.summary: Forensic labs, a national records network and rapid transport for every district.

units.name: Armed police battalion
units.summary: Reserve battalions that back up local police against serious crime and disorder.

units.name: Rapid response company
units.summary: Trained to calm crowds and protests before they turn into riots.

units.name: Cyber crime cell
units.summary: Investigators who chase fraud, scams and online crime.

units.name: Counter-terror squad
units.summary: A tactical team that stops attacks in progress and makes plots harder to carry out.

agencies.name: Intelligence service
agencies.summary: Watches for plots at home and abroad. Stronger, it uncovers more plots and lowers the terror threat.

agencies.name: Anti-corruption bureau
agencies.summary: Investigates officials. Stronger, it pushes corruption down and its audits find more.

agencies.name: Border police
agencies.summary: Guards crossings and coasts. Stronger, it keeps weapons and fighters out.

agencies.name: Presidential protection
agencies.summary: The close-protection service around the President.
